p.n: The Cautious Weak Is Better Than Deluded Strong

body.p:

who is cautious of the strong enemy is closer to safety than the proud enemy when he becomes
misled by the weak and open to him.

The sensible man makes peace with his enemy, if he is compelled unto him:
he treats him well, displays friendliness, and shows him some trust on his part-
if he can’t manage other than that; he then makes haste to part from him
when he finds a way for that.
It has been said that someone too quick to act openly can hardly be excused for his misstep;
